resources.string: Pick a language and a look you like — you can change them anytime in Settings.

Want rankings and community stats? Fill these in now — or finish the wizard first and set them up later in Settings.

To determine your platform name, platform ID, and API user ID, send the /tkls command and the /sessiontoken command to any bot running Phi-Plugin.

An API Token is also required to vote in chart tag polls. Send /setApiToken <customToken> to any Phi-Plugin bot to set it, then enter the token below. The token is only used to authenticate with the score lookup API; we never upload your sessionToken.
Your best plays become a shareable B30 image — pick a style you like, and switch it anytime in Settings.
Play a few songs and sync your scores first — then your B30 shows up right here.
Sign in and your cloud save syncs over — scores, B30 and the lookup tools all light up. Want to look around first? Tap "Look around first" below and sign in anytime.
Once they are in, song lists open instantly — even offline. In a hurry? Skip it and nothing breaks; you can grab them later in Settings.
The network seems grumpy. Try again — or skip it, nothing breaks.
We peek upstream for a fresher song database — one tap and chart info stays current.
Couldn’t check just now — probably the network. Mind retrying?
Want the app to watch for updates by itself? Tick what you care about — you can change it anytime in Settings.
Enjoy your journey through the doves!
A few quick steps and your score-tracking setup is done.
